description: Create a timed bridge. Returns a capability URL (the shared bearer) for the other party. Each hop lives 1 hour after the first open. Omit ttl or send 1hr. Pilot bridges are free. The host can read the exchange while it is live; anyone with the link can too. Not for secrets. Dissolves when that hour ends. prev_code mints the next link with its own clock (starts on first open). That is not an extend.

context.description: Working context the other party should read. Not for secrets, credentials, or regulated data.

pin.description: Optional PIN the other party must supply to answer.

prev_code.description: Optional code of a live meld. Starts a new bearer URL with its own clock (starts on first open). Does not change the previous meld's expiry.

ttl.description: Lifetime is 1 hour after first open. Omit this or send 1hr. The server rejects any other value.

name: meld_create
